description: This file defines data models for an API handling voice navigation commands and related entities using Pydantic. It includes classes for geographical coordinates, search requests and responses, routing, voice command processing, and location-based Q&A.

classes.name: LatLng
classes.description: Represents geographical coordinates with latitude and longitude.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Standardized error response envelope with code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: Envelope
classes.description: Standard success response envelope indicating operation success.

classes.name: PlaceCandidate
classes.description: Represents a place candidate returned from a search, with id, name, address, location, and types.

classes.name: RouteStep
classes.description: A step in a route with instructions, distance, and duration.

classes.name: RouteSummary
classes.description: High-level summary of a route including total distance, duration, polyline, and steps.

classes.name: VoiceCommandRequest
classes.description: Represents a transcribed voice command with optional user location and session id.

classes.name: VoiceCommandAction
classes.description: Normalized action derived from voice command, including type, query, origin, and destination.

classes.name: VoiceCommandResponse
classes.description: API response for a processed voice command, including session id, transcript, action, assistant text, and optional data.

classes.name: PlaceSearchRequest
classes.description: Request object for searching places with query, optional location, radius, and limit.

classes.name: PlaceSearchResponse
classes.description: Response with query echo and list of place candidates.

classes.name: DirectionsRequest
classes.description: Request object for obtaining directions, with origin/destination and mode.

classes.name: DirectionsResponse
classes.description: Response containing origin, destination, mode, and route summary.

classes.name: LocationQARequest
classes.description: Request for asking questions about a location with optional context.

classes.name: LocationQAResponse
classes.description: Response containing the answer, citations, and optional context for location Q&A.

methods.name: str _strip_query(cls, v: str)
methods.description: Validator that trims and ensures non-empty 'query' string in PlaceSearchRequest.

methods.name: str _strip_question(cls, v: str)
methods.description: Validator that trims and ensures non-empty 'question' in LocationQARequest.
